title: Historical quantity and condition series
description: Project every retained record in an exact inclusive interval, in bounded pages. Stateless item_quantity and condition_evaluation measurements reuse their authoritative query schemas. Quantity rates describe endpoint net changes; condition classifications never infer stability, deadline compliance, current state or watch completion. No capture or retained watch is advanced.

measurement.description: Closed until composed with the union of the authoritative item_quantity and condition_evaluation schemas and the existing shared predicate definitions.
